designer.title: Hybrid Designer and Engineer
designer.lead: Industrial Design Engineering student connecting human-centered design with technical execution
designer.description: Industrial Design Engineering student at TU Delft (Honours track) with a strong interest in interdisciplinary and impact-driven projects. I work at the intersection of design research, prototyping, and implementation to translate complex challenges into tangible solutions. I value critical thinking, experimentation, and collaboration across cultures and disciplines.

hybrid-design-engineering.title: Design + Engineering Integration
hybrid-design-engineering.description: I connect design research, concept development, and technical prototyping to move from idea to implementable solution.

impact-and-sustainability.title: Impact on People and Planet
impact-and-sustainability.description: I prioritize solutions that improve user well-being while considering environmental and social implications.

critical-and-experimental.title: Critical and Experimental Mindset
critical-and-experimental.description: I question assumptions, test alternatives, and iterate through evidence-based experimentation.

innovation-and-technology.title: Innovation Through Technology
innovation-and-technology.description: I use digital and physical prototyping tools to explore novel concepts and bring ideas into practice.

collaboration-and-leadership.title: Collaborative Project Work
collaboration-and-leadership.description: I contribute in multidisciplinary teams and take initiative in educational and community contexts.

international-and-multicultural.title: International and Multicultural Openness
international-and-multicultural.description: I thrive in diverse environments and communicate across languages and cultures.

design-research.name: Design research and concept development
design-research.description: User research, framing, and concept validation.

engineering-prototyping.name: Engineering and prototyping (including CAD modeling and prototype testing)
engineering-prototyping.description: From concept to physical or digital prototype.

sustainability-ethics.name: Sustainability and ethical decision-making
sustainability-ethics.description: Responsible design decisions for societal impact.

highlights.highlight: Mentored prospective students in 3 orientation initiatives: Girlsday, EJW, and OWee.
Supported TU Delft open days and remained active in the Industrial Design study association to strengthen student community engagement.
Compete in university skating activities and participate in sports communities, reinforcing consistency, teamwork, and discipline.
